title: A point of the target of a universally injective morphism over an algebraically closed field lifts to a point of the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a universally injective morphism of algebraic stacks and a point of the target over an algebraically closed field which lies in the image on spaces, there is a point of the source over that same field mapping to it (author lemma at source lines 2976-2984, label lemma-universally-injective-point). The proof (source lines 2986-3030) reduces by base change to a nonempty stack over an algebraically closed field, takes a field-valued flat surjective cover, uses the diagonal characterization of universal injectivity to get surjectivity of the comparison morphism, and then compares the two projections through the integral closure statement to force the field extension to be trivial. H3; the reduction is not the content, the comparison of the two projections and the closing field-theoretic argument (proof lines 3003-3029) are.
